records.title: Ripple and Bitso expand partnership for enterprise stablecoin settlement
records.summary: Ripple says Bitso's MXNB will be issued on XRPL and integrated into Ripple's Permissioned DEX infrastructure; RLUSD and MXNB are intended to support U.S.–Mexico enterprise settlement; Bitso remains a Ripple Payments and RLUSD partner.
records.limitations: Company statement establishes strategy and partnership, not transaction-level attribution for the observed wallet route or completed volumes.

records.title: Bitso and Ripple deliver cross-border exchange using ODL
records.summary: Ripple describes Bitso as a key exchange partner for U.S.–Mexico ODL; its account says USD is converted to XRP, transferred on XRPL and exchanged into MXN through Bitso's liquidity pool.
records.limitations: Historical company account of ODL usage; does not prove the 2026 observed route is an ODL payment.

records.title: Ripple's 2019 investment in Bitso
records.summary: Ripple announced that it led an investment round in Bitso and that Ripple's Asheesh Birla would join Bitso's board; Ripple described Bitso as a key liquidity partner for its U.S.–Mexico corridor.
records.limitations: Historical corporate statement; current equity ownership and board composition require current filings or company confirmation.

records.title: Bitso Business institutional payments and liquidity overview
records.summary: Bitso Business describes local payment rails, stablecoin and liquidity infrastructure, reports US$6.7B transaction volume in 2024 and 1,900+ institutional clients, and identifies Ripple as a critical cross-border payments partner.
records.limitations: Company-reported operating metrics; does not attribute the observed XRPL transactions or identify the Bitso destination-tag owner.
